products.name: InternLM (Shanghai AI Lab)
products.note: Chinese open-source LLM; academic research; cross-border data review advised

reading.body:
Shanghai AI Laboratory is a government-affiliated research institution in China operating InternLM, an open-source large language model positioned for academic research across Chinese universities and scientific applications.

The laboratory's stated focus spans model capability, embodied robotics, and AI safety frameworks, with recent emphasis on science-oriented systems that integrate language models, specialist agents, and physical automation. This portfolio suggests a research strategy prioritizing broad capability development rather than any single domain constraint. The 2026 announcement of AI-for-science results and a scientific discovery platform indicates the institution is testing large models as infrastructure for experimental workflows, from hypothesis through validation.

What matters for AI infrastructure is that Shanghai AI Laboratory operates within China's university and research ecosystem, not as a commercial infrastructure builder or power provider. The laboratory contributes to model capability and research methodology but does not control the compute, buildings, or power grids that determine how quickly those capabilities can scale. It represents the downstream user of infrastructure, not the constraint that binds it.

The data does not cover the laboratory's budget, its access to compute hardware, or the power requirements of its training and inference systems. Without those facts, the connection between its research ambitions and the infrastructure constraints that may or may not enable them remains unmeasured.

profile_text.body:
Shanghai AI Laboratory is a non-profit government lab whose website describes it as recruiting global talent across artificial intelligence, large models, embodied intelligence, safe and trustworthy AI, AI for Science, basic platforms, the innovation chain, and management support, with the stated aim of working toward AGI. The site says that since 2022 the lab has run a joint doctoral training program with more than ten universities, naming Peking University, Tsinghua University, Fudan University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Tongji University, the University of Science and Technology of China, and Zhejiang University. It also describes a 2026 global campus recruitment drive and a talent program it calls "North Star."

On the product side, the lab is tracked for InternLM, described as a Chinese open-source large language model in the chat and general LLM category, with a note that it is used in academic research and that cross-border data review is advised. The site says the lab released the Shusheng Duanyan scientific discovery platform at the 2026 WAIC Science Frontier Forum, covering the research workflow from hypothesis to experimental verification and connecting science models, specialized agents, experimental data, and embodied automation equipment. It also reports ten joint science innovation results released with Shusheng across life sciences, materials science, and deep space astronomy, an open-source architecture called Mobius for long-horizon reasoning and scientific discovery, and Intern-Robotics, an embodied full-stack engine. The lab describes a general and specialized integration system in three layers, a foundation model layer, a fusion coordination layer, and an exploration and evolution layer, and sets out an "AI-45 degree balance law" for safety and performance along with a causal path to trustworthy AGI through pan-alignment, intervenability, and reflection, plus risk management it describes as assessment, training, foundation, application, and verification.

The record held for the lab lists no litigation and no MCP servers.
